notes:
Regenerated once, at the end of W20, on an otherwise idle machine. No golden
replay fixture was regenerated. The default scenario still permits only the v1
rectangle (fullGridAtFounding defaults to 0), so these baselines describe the
twelve-cell universe, not the full grid. No release before 0.5.0 may claim any of
these numbers is balanced.

The universe remains degenerate in ways this workstream measured and did not
close, and these numbers should be read against that. permit-then-idle -- a bot
that permits every technique and form for 140 of 2400 ticks and then submits
nothing at all -- still wins 12/12 on the true-naming arm, tying the strategy
that funds, blesses and encourages, because permit is still the only god verb
whose payoff is not dominated. Only 2 of 10 strategies ascend at all, so D3
(three strategies winning at materially different rates) still fails. In the wide
configuration content exhaustion returns at 318 of 347 nodes rather than being
removed. And most authored world-scale content is still inert: eleven
universe-target resource-yield effects are the whole of what reaches the world
stack, because the per-mage effect channel does not exist. These three gate
sweeps are 100 percent passive-control and submit no god verb.
rationale:
W20 made previously-inert content live and replaced the v1 knowledge graph.
Five mechanisms move these numbers, and each is measured rather than asserted.
(1) The v1 graph went from 51 ladder nodes to 108 compositional ones, tiers 1-7
where it previously stopped at 5, so every acquisition path is different and
deeper species reach further. (2) researchCost stopped being a pure function of
tier -- 6 to 16 distinct values within every tier now, from the per-technique
cost curves -- so the global acquisition order is gone. (3) knowledgeEffectHooks
wired held knowledge into the world-tick (1+SIGMA) channels for the first time;
resource-yield is the largest live mover at 11 universe-target v1 effects, and
the previously-hardcoded empty arrays for resource-yield and fertility now carry
node-sourced magnitudes. (4) lifespan changed stacking from additive to
diminishing, so stacked extensions have logarithmic returns. (5) Per-mage track
exclusions and anti-requisites refuse acquisitions that were previously legal,
which lowers what any one mage holds and raises how much mages differ.
Species affinities also gained v1-rectangle forms, without which the affinity
term in target-appeal.ts had nothing to read for human or gnome.
Measured deltas are in docs/design/compositional-content.md section 6.6.
These numbers are a MEASUREMENT, not a balance claim. release-plan.md forbids any
balance claim before 0.5.0, and every magnitude behind these figures is still
tuningStatus "untuned" -- so this baseline records what the simulation does, not
what anyone has decided it should do.
